name: certscore-website-privacy-preflight
description: Evidence-backed public-website privacy preflight with fast preliminary cookie/tracker evidence and bounded post-refusal review.

interface.shortDescription: Preview cookies and trackers, then report.
interface.longDescription: Use CertScore.ai MCP Light to run or reuse a bounded public-website scan. New scans may quickly return a clearly labeled preliminary cookie/tracker preview while the canonical report is still being prepared. Continue through completion for final returned totals, findings, provenance, coverage limitations, consent controls, policy signals, HTTPS/TLS, and—on eligible sites—non-essential activity observed after a confirmed Reject action.
defaultPrompt: Run a fresh privacy preflight for https://ergoveritas.com/.well-known/certscore-canary/sentinels/broad-baseline.html. Show any preliminary cookie and tracker preview immediately, then continue to the final report.
Review https://ergoveritas.com/.well-known/certscore-canary/runtime/storage.html and distinguish the fast preliminary storage evidence from the completed scan results.
Check https://ergoveritas.com/.well-known/certscore-canary/post-refusal/reject-ignored.html for eligible activity after a confirmed Reject action.
